details: CONFIRMED by probe: relay_queue.parse of an item with the two notes above, _not_reproduced -> True.
_not_reproduced is any() over all fact notes, so the oldest negative note wins over every later positive one; the
only way back is hand-editing the note. The live queue holds one such pair (alix-bin-wt-makes-worktree-but-relay-expects-wor:
HIT on "the item itself says it was not reproduced", then "reproduced 29 Oct"); had it been open, it would be hidden.
A quoted review line is caught too: a fact "Review F2: PLAUSIBLE (traced, not reproduced); a test is needed." skips the
item (probe -> True), and relay's reviews write "PLAUSIBLE (... not reproduced ...)" often (19 times in 18 review files under .relay/checks on master).
Size: 15 minutes (newest fact note mentioning reproduction decides; anchor the phrase at the note's start).
evidence: HIT  closed alix-bin-wt-makes-worktree-but-relay-expects-wor | ... The item itself says it was not reproduced.
failing_case: Item X (fix, ip 99), notes in date order: fact "29 Oct, not reproduced (front): no longer fails.", then fact
"Reproduced 29 Oct: bin/wt line 5 creates .worktree/." (this exact pair is live history: the ALIX bin/wt item got a
"was not reproduced" note, then "reproduced 29 Oct", then was built). One free lane, Y (ip 90) also open.
Now: _not_reproduced(X) is True, X is never a pick, never in "next", never in "waits": it vanishes from the lanes line
and the Stop nudge, and nothing tells the front why. Should: the newest reproduction fact decides; X is the pick.
fix_hint: Take the newest fact note that mentions reproduction and skip only when it is a negative one; better, match only a
note that starts with the fixed marker the front writes ("<date>, not reproduced"), so quoted review text does not count.
Add the "later reproduced" case to tests/test_lanes_state.py next to stuck_queue.
pass_cases: 1. X with "not reproduced" then a later "Reproduced 29 Oct" fact, Y open, one free lane: picks == ["x"], next names y.
2. X with only "29 Oct, not reproduced (front)" fact, Y open, one free lane: picks == ["y"] (today's test stays green).
3. X with a "Reproduced 29 Oct" fact only: X is the pick.
4. lanes_line_items = 0 with case 2: "Lanes: 0 of 1 running; start: y (fix, ip 90)".
reason: tests/test_lanes_state.py:324 test_f1_the_newest_reproduction_fact_decides covers all four pass cases; fails at 80e76a44.

details: CONFIRMED by probe: _not_reproduced on parsed items -> "did not reproduce" False, "could not reproduce" False.
Live: of the 4 negative reproduction notes in the queue, 2 say "not reproduced" and 2 say "did not / could not reproduce";
the phrase catches half. Principle 5 ("a regex or word list trying to catch intent": facts go to code or a fixed list) and
principle 4 / the structured-data rule (a script reading a state out of prose) fire. The item's own What chose "a 'not
reproduced' fact note", a front-made, agent-chosen design, so changing it to a structured marker is a design decision.
Design: how "not reproduced" is stored: a phrase inside a free-text fact note (today) versus a dated structured event
written by one command (for example a note kind or a field `not_reproduced_at`, cleared by a later reproduced event).
Size: 30 minutes for a marker in relay_queue plus the lanes check and tests.
evidence: probe: did not reproduce -> [] False ; could not reproduce -> [] False
scan: MISS closed live-hook-test-sometimes-misses-the-worker-addit | 27 oct, hook-flake lane: did not reproduce. ...
MISS closed a-train-test-fails-in-the-inert-probe-run-not-on | ... the worker could not reproduce the failure ...
failing_case: Item X first in order with the fact note "27 Oct, hook-flake lane: did not reproduce. 8 of 8 passed." (live wording,
live-hook-test-sometimes-misses-the-worker-addit) or "the worker could not reproduce the failure" (live wording,
a-train-test-fails-in-the-inert-probe-run-not-on), or a Russian note "не воспроизводится". One free lane, Y second.
Now: X is the pick and the line names only X: the 29 Oct failing case again. Should: Y is the pick.
fix_hint: Inside the design (cheap): a fixed marker the front writes at the start of the fact ("not reproduced"), stated in the
front skill, and only that counts. Outside it: a dated structured event in the queue item, written by one relay queue
pass_cases: 1. X marked not reproduced through the command/field the fix introduces (whatever its wording), Y open, one free lane: picks == ["y"].
2. X with a prose fact "did not reproduce" and no marker: the outcome the decision names (either skipped, or a pick), stated in a test.
3. X with no marker: X is the pick.
4. The marker is written by one command (e.g. relay queue note ... ) and shown by relay queue show.
reason: Marker is the field reproduced on a fact note: tests/test_lanes_state.py:336 (prose wordings stay picks), :341 (writer validates, keeps, shows it). Fails at 80e76a44.
findings.summary: the skip rests on one English phrase in prose (principle 5): 'did not reproduce' and 'could not reproduce', both live wordings, are not caught
